youtube.baslik: What can an ABR curve say about where a hearing loss lies? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The latency-intensity function shows how wave V latency lengthens as intensity drops. In conductive loss the curve shifts right, parallel to normal; in cochlear loss the slope is steep; in a retrocochlear pattern latency is long at every intensity. These curves are examples, and findings are interpreted together with other tests.
